theme_overview.name: Hybrid Spiritual Heritage
theme_overview.description: A premium, elegant, trustworthy Indian travel-company design. The hero section is dark navy with gold accents, peacock feather motifs, and ornate divine frames featuring 'Radhe Radhe' spiritual tagline. It transitions gracefully into a clean, well-lit content area with soft shadows, rounded corners, and deep navy text. It must not look like a generic AI template.

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, Lato, or Open Sans.
Ensure H1/H2 have tight tracking (tracking-tight) to enhance the elegant Serif feel.
Use the 'accent' font strictly for the 'Radhe Radhe' tagline, 'Tours and Travels' flourishes, or subtle decorative dividers.
Body text should be highly legible with leading-relaxed.

layouts.spacing_philosophy: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 to create breathing room.

grids.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12 with asymmetrical spanning.
grids.bento_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 with dense packing.
grids.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl) with soft ambient shadows on light backgrounds. On dark backgrounds, use 1px solid gold/white opacity borders.

hero_section.background: Dark Navy with a subtle radial gradient or texture overlay.
hero_section.content_alignment: Centered for the main spiritual hero to emphasize divine symmetry, but transitioning to left-aligned for content sections below.
hero_section.decorations: Gold ornate dividers, subtle peacock feather imagery blended into the background corners.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffused, multi-layered shadows on light cards. Example: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)].
visual_enhancers.borders: Use border-gold-500/20 for delicate separations in dark mode. Use border-slate-200 in light mode.
visual_enhancers.transitions: Smooth transitions on hover: 'transition-transform duration-300 ease-out hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl'.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky nav or floating booking widgets over the hero. Must use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px inner border for optical clarity.
visual_enhancers.dividers: Use custom SVG gold ornamental dividers between major sections instead of flat straight lines.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0B132B] font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#F3E5AB] transition-all
buttons.secondary: border-2 border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#D4AF37]/10 transition-all (On dark bg)
buttons.outlineDark: border-2 border-[#0B132B] text-[#0B132B] rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#0B132B] hover:text-white transition-all (On light bg)

cards.fleet: Clean white background, high-quality vehicle image, pill-shaped tags for specs (AC, Luggage, Seats), deep navy title, prominent CTA.
cards.destination: Image-first with gradient overlay at the bottom. Title in Playfair Display. Hover effect zooms the image slightly.
cards.admin_widget: Flat solid surfaces, crisp 1px borders, left-aligned text, clear data hierarchy. No glassmorphism in admin.

booking_widget.style: Floating glass card overlapping the dark hero and the light section below it. Highly structured inputs using custom Shadcn forms. Clear steps.

motion.scroll: Use Framer Motion for subtle fade-in-up as the user scrolls into light content sections.
motion.hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow expansion for clickable cards.

hero_decorations.description: Macro peacock feather for subtle corner or background blending in the dark hero.

A captivating view through India Gate's arch at sunset.
A beautifully detailed white marble temple with intricate carvings and domed architecture.
Ornate white temple with steps under a clear blue sky

fleet.description: White SUV car driving on highway

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Execute the hybrid theme strictly: Dark Navy/Gold Hero -> Crisp White/Light Pearl Content.
Use Playfair Display for all main headers, Great Vibes exclusively for 'Radhe Radhe' and decorative accents, and Outfit for readable body text.
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, navbars, or widgets sitting over images. Use solid colors or heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl) with inner borders.
Create custom UI components where Shadcn falls short for the marketing pages, but rely on Shadcn strictly for the Admin Dashboard and complex Booking Form.
Every interactive element and key informational text MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="book-now-hero-cta"').
Implement the specific Booking ID format: 'RRT-YYYY-NNNN'.
Embed WhatsApp Click-to-Chat functionality and a Sticky Call Button on the client side.
Configure LocalBusiness Structured Data (JSON-LD) for SEO in the document head.
Images provided must be used exactly as mapped. Do not substitute with fake placeholder text.
instructions_to_main_agent.icon_library: @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react (Prefer Phosphor for a more premium, duotone aesthetic if possible, else stick to Lucide but styled gracefully).
